title: Open Balance of a Ridgeline Installation Services Contract
content:
**Clause.** The final settlement payment is the open balance of the contract: the contract price billed, plus every change order billed, every measure fee charged and every fee charged, plus every refund paid out, less every payment received and every credit applied, all read from the contract's lines and rounded to the cent. The final settlement payment is rounded to the cent at the end.

## How each line of a Ridgeline Installation Services contract enters the open balance

| Contract line | Enters the open balance |
|---|---|
| contract price billed at signing | added |
| change order billed | added |
| measure fee charged | added |
| fee charged (reschedule fee, trip charge, cancellation fee, permit fee, permit handling fee, haul-away fee, change order administration fee) | added |
| refund paid out | added |
| payment received (measure fee, deposit, progress, change order, fee or final payment) | subtracted |
| credit applied (measure fee credit, installer no-show credit, delay credit, change order reduction) | subtracted |
| visit record | no effect; a visit line moves no money |

## Worked example (hypothetical contract)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| contract price billed | 6000.00 |
| measure fee charged | 99.00 |
| change order billed | 400.00 |
| fees charged | 150.00 |
| payments received (measure fee 99.00, deposit 3000.00) | 3099.00 |
| credits applied (measure fee credit) | 99.00 |
| refunds paid out | 0.00 |

The open balance is 6000.00 plus 99.00, 400.00 and 150.00, less 3099.00 and 99.00, which is 3451.00, and the final settlement payment on these lines is 3451.00.

## Basis questions answered

**Is the balance taken from the customer's statement or from the lines?** From the contract's lines, each read as recorded and summed by kind.

**Why does a refund increase the amount?** A refund pays money back out to the customer, so it adds back to what remains owed on the contract.
